visual_appeal: Pull every surface onto one material ramp: panel #16110d, inset well #221a14, 1px inner rule #5c4a32. The options page is a lighter chocolate slab than the near-black ElvUI frame around it, and the timeline plot reads as a flat hole.
Give the timeline plot 10px inset, a #2c241c plot fill, and vertical gridlines at 20% white so the chart has the same depth as the roster wells.
Stack the three alerts as one family: identical width, 8px gap, shared 1px #6b5428 border and the same rivet corners as the main frame.
play_next_clarity: The gold box is on step 2 (Le Dette: play now) while the real next action is step 1. Invert it: 28px-tall gold well on step 1 only, copy Hearth Le Jette first — Feralas is not an inn. Step 2 stays plain 13px cream: Then play Le Dette (1.5 levels, double XP).
Hero kicker #1 PLAY NEXT fights that instruction. Change the kicker to FULL — 1.5 LEVELS and add one 13px line under the name: After you hearth, this is the character to log.
Subline under the steps is easy to miss. Make Then play Le Bankken, full in 19h 11m 13px St.SECOND and prefix it with a 3. label so the queue is 1 hearth, 2 Le Dette, 3 Le Bankken.
state_colours: Status sentences are cream, so a short bar carries the whole state. Tint them: full #8fd18a, nearly #f0c84a, resting #e8943a, not-resting #ff6b5a, all 13px.
Left state rail is a hairline. Make it 6px and run it the full 62px row, including NOW PLAYING, so colour is scannable without reading the chip.

Nearly-full yellow #e2b43a and resting orange #d4782a are close on the brown well. Shift resting bars to #e07a28 and nearly-full to #f2d15a, and keep chip fills 20% darker than the bar so chip and bar are not the same swatch.
character_identity: Race/gender badges are too small to identify. Draw them at 20px, 2px #0e0c0a ring, sitting 2px outside the portrait, same corner on hero, rows, and card.
Account 3 sits on the name line and breaks the name column. Move it to the end of the 13px meta line as a 12px caps chip, #2a3344 fill, #9ec4ff text.

Card repeats Le Beouf in the title and the body. Leave the title as the name; drop the second heading and use that 16px slot for Level 11 Tauren Druid so the speech bubble is the personality, not a duplicate label.
default_theme: Default still reads as ElvUI with a moon. Buttons must be stock UIPanel grey-gold: fill #4a3c28, border #c4a050, text #ffd100. No blue #2f6fbf on Compact, View details, or All accounts.
Title bar: Friz Quadrata 16px #ffd100, stone Dialog border, panel fill #1a120c. Keep the moon, but at 16px #ffd100, 8px left of the title, not a different font than the rows.
Row wells and chips in default should be #2a2118 with #8a7040 borders, not the same warm-gold ElvUI chip. A side-by-side glance should tell the themes apart with buttons alone.
elvui_wc3_fit: Options content is lighter than the ElvUI options shell in the reference. Set that page to #0e0e0e with section labels in the skin gold #ffcc00 and body #c8c0b0, matching Controls.
Main roster wells should match the character frame darkness, about #12100e, with the WC3 8px corner rivets used on the alert cards so the roster, card, and movers are one skin.
Selected row and the Move notifications button can stay ElvUI blue #1a6fd4; do not also gold-fill them or the skin reads as two addons.
alerts_ux: Three cards say the same thing. If the logout warning is up, suppress Find an inn and Rested XP used up. One card: title Rest at an inn before logging out, body Cancel logout, then hearth to Feathermoon Stronghold. Le Jette is not resting. Next line: Next: Le Dette, full, 1.5 levels.
Force one width, 480px, one close X 12px from the right, one View details button. The current stack is three different widths with the action button only on the top card.
Gear icon is unexplained. Replace it with a 13px text button Alert settings, or drop it and keep right-click. Add a 4px red left rail only on the logout card so severity is obvious.
readability: Timeline ticks (Now, +12h, +24h, +36h, +48h) are dim small caps. Set them to 13px #e6d3b0. On #1a140f that clears 7:1; the current grey-brown does not.
FULL AFTER 48h dates and BY TIME TO FULL are under the 13px floor. Dates 13px #d4c4a8, right column 120px wide. Header labels 12px #e6d3b0 with 1px tracking, not a thinner grey.
Jacques Hammer wraps onto the detail line. Keep one line at 13px: Not filling — rest at an inn. Row stays 62px with 8px clear above the hover detail strip.
layout_polish: Alert cards do not share a column. Same left edge, width 480px, 6px vertical gap, close controls on one x.
Timeline right column is overflowing. Reserve 132px, left of that a 8px gutter, bars stop before the gutter. Night bands 22:00-06:00 at #000000 28% opacity across the plot or they are invisible.

Options: LOW REST WARNING shares a row with the account radios and the 5% label sits on the track. Give the slider its own row, 280px track, 13px labels 6px above the track, knob not covering the 10% caption.
Chips: lock width at 118px so NEARLY FULL, RESTING, and NOT RESTING share one right edge with the NOW PLAYING chip. Value column ends 8px before that.
delight: My imp is bored. is a tiny tag on the portrait. Set it as a 13px italic line under the hero meta, #e6d3b0, so the personality is readable.
More rest is wasted. sounds like a scold. Use Bank is full — time logged out now will not add XP.
Resting portraits get the card zzz at 12px, 80% opacity, top-right of the icon, so the roster feels asleep the way the Le Beouf card does. Keep the speech bubble only on the card.

overall_notes: The roster type scale and column grid landed: 13px meta, 62px rows, chips and the NOW PLAYING chip on one right edge, and the hero queue is finally a real sequence. That is enough to lift readability to an 8. It is not shippable for a demanding user yet. The gold highlight is on the second action, three logout alerts repeat one fact at three widths, the timeline ticks fail contrast and the not-filling line collides with the detail strip, and default versus ElvUI is still mostly a button colour. Fix highlight order, dedupe alerts onto one width, and give the timeline a real 13px axis before calling v1.1 done.
